# Saint Red Paper

Saint Red Paper is light-first with a matching dark mode, aiming at notes that read like white paper. Headings, spacing, blockquotes, callouts, inline code and Dataview tables are tuned for long-form research and lab logs, and restrained red-paper accents are applied to sidebars, links, tags and notices.

![Saint Red Paper screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saint0721/saint-red-paper/HEAD/assets/saint-red-paper-community.png)
